page_title: UDI 1-2 GEN | Udinese v Genoa 08/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Fabio Maresca has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+5' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Nicola Leali was alert and the score remains the same.
90+4' Rui Modesto (Udinese) sends a cross into the box, but Nicola Leali comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+3' Genoa try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
86' Sandi Lovric joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese).
86' That's the end of the game for Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese), who is replaced by Iker Bravo.
85' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Adam Buksa (Udinese). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar.

83' 1 - 2 Goal! Caleb Ekuban manages to prod the ball to Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
80' A pass finds the feet of Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) on the edge of the box and he sends in a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's easily gathered by the goalkeeper.
79' Udinese are ruled offside.
76' Here is a change. Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) is going off and Daniele De Rossi gives the last tactical orders to Junior Messias.
75' The referee signals a substitution. Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) is brought on as a substitute for Lorenzo Colombo.
74' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) makes a rough challenge and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul.
73' Przemyslaw Malecki has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kingsley Ehizibue replacing Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese).
72' The referee allows time for a substitution. Keinan Davis will be replaced by Adam Buksa (Udinese).
70' Oumar Solet (Udinese) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.

68' Alessandro Marcandalli (Genoa) wastes a huge opportunity. He attempts to knock a rebound inside the right post with a delicate header, but Maduka Okoye dives to keep the ball from hitting the net.
66' What was Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

65' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Rui Modesto plays the ball to the feet of Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese), who hits a tremendous first-time shot into the top left corner. The goalkeeper was unable to keep it out. 1:1.
63' Daniele De Rossi has decided to make a change. Caleb Ekuban replaces Vitinha (Genoa).
62' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
61' It will be a corner kick for Udinese.
59' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.

59' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Fabio Maresca stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Udinese will take a free kick near the side line.
58' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) commits a foul during an attacking move.
54' Oumar Solet (Udinese) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Nicola Leali, who smothers the ball.
53' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Udinese, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
53' Vitinha (Genoa) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul. Udinese win a free kick.
52' Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) is furious with himself as he misses a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.
51' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

51' Nicola Leali stretches to his right and makes a brilliant save! Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper into the bottom right corner. The ball goes behind for a corner. Udinese will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
50' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
50' Keinan Davis (Udinese) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
50' Keinan Davis (Udinese) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
49' A rebound falls kindly for Patrizio Masini (Genoa), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
48' Genoa fail to score from a corner as Maduka Okoye (Udinese) leaps to collect the ball.

48' Vitinha (Genoa) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the roof of the net, but Maduka Okoye was alert and the score remains the same. The referee points to the corner flag and Genoa will take a corner.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
45+2' A bullet header by Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards wide of the left post.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
43' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
42' Corner kick. Udinese will have an opportunity.

42' Rui Modesto (Udinese) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the underside of the crossbar is, however, superbly saved by Nicola Leali!
38' Oumar Solet (Udinese) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
37' Aaron Martin (Genoa) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
36' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle as Keinan Davis (Udinese) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
34' 0 - 1 GOAL! Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) sends the penalty kick into the right of the net.
34' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
34' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle after Maduka Okoye (Udinese) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. PENALTY! One of the players from Genoa is about to take a penalty kick.

32' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Nicola Leali easily catches the ball.
31' Rui Modesto crosses the ball right onto the head of Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese), but his firm header from around the penalty spot shoots well wide of the right post.
31' 45:55 – the ratio of ball possession.
27' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
25' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
24' Rui Modesto (Udinese) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
22' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
22' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) was too forceful with his tackle and Fabio Maresca interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
19' Keinan Davis (Udinese) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.
18' The ball is cleared after Rui Modesto (Udinese) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
15' Problems for Przemyslaw Malecki as Jordan Zemura is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Rui Modesto (Udinese) replaces him.

13' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
11' The game is interrupted now, Jordan Zemura (Udinese) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
9' Keinan Davis (Udinese) has a goal ruled out for offside!
8' Vitinha (Genoa) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
6' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Nicola Leali.
5' Alessandro Marcandalli (Genoa) brings an opponent down and Fabio Maresca interrupts the game. Udinese have a free kick.
2' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Udinese will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Fabio Maresca.
